message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.6,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or weighted vote fairly compares the three budget-allocation options, but should account for shared criteria such as member development, equipment urgency, expected impact, and feasibility rather than relying solely on debate performance.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Prioritizes an inter-city tournament with hospitality and prizes to increase club visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.3},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Prioritizes spending the full budget on new educational equipment because existing boards and resources are worn.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Supports an equal split between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance outreach and pedagogy.","influence":0.3}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The three positions reflect legitimate but competing objectives, and the counter-arguments identify weaknesses in each option. A social-choice process using transparent criteria and ranked preferences is appropriate; a compromise, potentially a modified hybrid with minimum viable equipment purchases and a scaled tournament, can preserve both operational quality and development goals."}
